n, m, P = map(int, input().split())
f = [0] * (m + 1)
g = [0] * (m + 1)
C = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]

f[0] = 1
for i in range(m + 1):
    C[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % P

def add(x, y):
    x += y
    if x >= P:
        x -= P
    return x

for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        f[i] = add(f[i], (f[j - 1] * f[i - j] % P) * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1] % P)
        g[i] = add(g[i], ((f[j - 1] * g[i - j] + f[i - j] * g[j - 1]) % P) * (i + 1) % P * C[i - 1][j - 1] % P)
        g[i] = add(g[i], (C[j][2] + C[i - j + 1][2]) * f[j - 1] % P * f[i - j] % P * C[i - 1][j - 1] % P)

p = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
q = [[0] * (m + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
p[0][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    for j in range(min(i, m + 1)):
        for k in range(j + 1):
            p[i][j] = add(p[i][j], p[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k] % P * C[j][k] % P)
            q[i][j] = add(q[i][j], (p[i - k - 1][j - k] * g[k] + q[i - k - 1][j - k] * f[k]) % P * C[j][k] % P)
    if i <= m:
        p[i][i] = f[i]
        q[i][i] = g[i]

print(q[n][m])
